## Summary

Describe the behavior change and link the issue.

## Documentation impact

Identify affected README/operations sections and the source or commands used to
verify them. If no documentation change is needed, explain why the current
documentation remains accurate. Do not make a cosmetic edit just to touch README.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results, including
`node scripts/check-docs.mjs` and `node --test scripts/check-docs.test.mjs`.
Note any limits, failures or deployment blockers.
